goal:
This project folder is empty. Write a single Python file `stats.py` with three pure functions: `mean(xs)`, `median(xs)` and `mode(xs)`. Each raises ValueError with a clear message on an empty list. `mode` returns the smallest value when several tie.

Also write `test_stats.py`: a plain Python script (no pytest) that checks each function on known inputs, checks the tie-breaking, checks all three error cases, prints one 'OK:' line per check, and exits 0 only if every check passed.

Verify by running: python test_stats.py. Report the exit code you actually saw.
